info.title: Indexed.vc API
info.description:
Company intelligence API providing comprehensive data on private companies,
funding history, and investor relationships.

## Authentication & tiers
All authenticated endpoints require an `X-API-Key` header. Every plan can
create a key, and every plan can pull depth:
  - **Free** — company & investor card search by name or domain (web parity
    with the public site, 25 searches a day), entity detail and `POST /reveal`
    paid from its 25 monthly credits, `/industries`, `/usage`.
  - **Every paid plan (Silver and up)** — adds the bulk and automation surface:
    filter-only listing with sorting, bulk enrichment, tech/app-stack search,
    funding-alert webhooks, scheduled exports, plus far more credits and
    searches. Paid tiers differ by volume (credits, keys, rate limit, reveal
    batch), not by whether depth exists.
Endpoints beyond a tier's capability return `403 TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED`.
Credit exhaustion returns `402 CREDIT_LIMIT_REACHED` with `top_up_url`,
`upgrade_url` and `next_plan`.
The free `/industries` endpoint is publicly accessible without a key.

## Credits
Most endpoints consume credits. Costs are documented per-endpoint.
Detail fetches cache the same entity and depth for 12 months. Reveal and enrich share the existing entity reveal cache; a reveal does not waive every detail action.

## Rate Limiting
All authenticated responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`,
and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

## Request Correlation
Every authenticated response includes an `X-Request-Id` header (UUID v4).
Include this in support requests for fast debugging. The unauthenticated
`/industries` endpoint is CDN-cached for 24h and carries no request id.

get.description:
Search and filter companies. Every result is the full public card; `_revealed` marks entities whose depth (funding history, valuations, stacks) you have unlocked.
Standard search is free within the daily quota; paid plans spend 1 credit
per nonempty page afterward, while Free stops with SEARCH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
Premium search (techStack/appStack filters)
costs 3 credits on the first nonempty page; subsequent pages with a valid
`X-Search-Session` token are free for 15 minutes. Empty `data` pages consume
no delivered-search quota or credits even when `meta.total` is positive;
an unpaid empty premium page does not issue a session token. Request-rate
limits still apply.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text search query

parameters.name: industries
parameters.description: Comma-separated industry filters. Accepts display labels (Fintech), case variants (fintech), or slugs (ai-ml). Use GET /industries for valid values.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated country names (e.g., United States,United Kingdom)

parameters.name: employees
parameters.description: Comma-separated employee ranges: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, 10001+. Unsupported ranges return 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. URL-encode + as %2B.

parameters.name: operatingStatus
parameters.description: Comma-separated: active, acquired, ipo, closed, merged

parameters.name: minFunding
parameters.description: Minimum total funding (total_funding_raised, grants included) in whole USD

parameters.name: maxFunding
parameters.description: Maximum total funding (total_funding_raised, grants included) in whole USD

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Match a company by its website domain (enrichment lookup, e.g. stripe.com). EXACT registrable-domain matching: matches mercury.com and any subdomain (www./app.mercury.com) but never superstrings like bluemercury.com. Accepts bare domains or full URLs.

parameters.name: minCompleteness
parameters.description: Minimum data_completeness_score — skip thin records

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Incremental sync: only records modified at/after this ISO date or timestamp (updated_at watermark). Combine with cursor pagination for drift-free delta pulls.

parameters.name: techStack
parameters.description: Comma-separated technology names (triggers premium search: 3 credits)

parameters.name: appStack
parameters.description: Comma-separated app/tool names (triggers premium search: 3 credits)

parameters.name: stackMatch
parameters.description: Match mode for tech/app stack filters

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page. Paid search supports up to 100; Free is capped at 10. meta.limit reports the effective page size after plan caps.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paid plans only. Keyset cursor for sequential bulk pulls. Free keys use page=1 through page=3. Pass meta.next_cursor from the prior page; ignores page/sort.

parameters.name: reveal_status
parameters.description: Filter results by reveal state

parameters.name: X-Search-Session
parameters.description: Session token for free premium search pagination (15-min TTL)

200.description: Search results (full public cards with reveal flags)

coverage_requested.description: Present on a zero-result exact-domain lookup: true when durably queued for coverage, false when persistence failed and the client should retry later, or when the domain belongs to a company outside coverage scope. The lookup remains free.

coverage_status.description: Present on a zero-result exact-domain lookup, and on a zero-result name search (q without filters). For a name search it is pending_enrichment, scope_review or not_in_coverage_scope when we hold a company with exactly that name, otherwise not_found (name misses are reviewed as search demand; nothing is promised). For a domain lookup: queued: recorded for coverage review. not_queued: recording failed; retry later. pending_enrichment: we hold this company but its profile is not yet complete enough to serve. scope_review: we hold it and its fit with coverage scope is under review. not_in_coverage_scope: we hold it but it is outside coverage scope (for example a consultancy), so it will not be served and coverage_requested is false.

post.summary: Look up up to 100 company domains
post.description:
Batch form of `GET /companies?domain=…`. Inputs are normalized and
deduplicated in first-seen order. Each delivered hit costs 1 credit;
misses are free. A miss reports whether review was durably queued,
is pending enrichment, needs scope review, or is outside our coverage;
no miss promises admission. Alias and
former-domain hits include `domain_match` so a different canonical
website is explicit rather than surprising.

X-Credits-Cost.description: Total credits charged for delivered hits

X-Credits-Remaining.description: Current combined included and pack balance after delivered hits

get.description:
Fetch a single company profile. Cost varies by depth:

**valuation_events field schema** (returned at `depth=full`): each
round object carries `event_type`, `round_name`, `amount_raised_usd`
(whole USD; also mirrored as `amount_raised`), `announced_date`
(YYYY-MM-DD), `pre_money_valuation` / `post_money_valuation`,
`press_url`, `confidence_score`, and `participants[]` (investors with
`is_lead`). Note: valuation-only events (409A marks, some tender
offers) legitimately have `amount_raised_usd: null` — a null amount
is "undisclosed/not applicable", not missing data. `data_as_of` on the
response is when this record was last verified by enrichment.

- `slim` (1 credit): identity fields only
- `standard` (2 credits): company scalars plus reviewed ownership links; no funding events, valuations or stack
- `full` (3 credits): complete data — funding rounds, investors, tech/app stack, valuations

503.description: Requested entity preparation unavailable (DATA_UNAVAILABLE) or credit service unavailable (SYSTEM_ERROR). Incomplete requested entity reads and cache-read failures do not charge. A lost deduction response can have an unknown billing outcome; check credit usage before retrying.

post.summary: Bulk enrich companies by domain or slug
post.description:
The GTM/RevOps query: submit a list of domains (or slugs) and get the
matched company records back. Domain matching is EXACT
registrable-domain (mercury.com matches Mercury at mercury.com or any
of its subdomains — never superstrings like bluemercury.com); you are
never billed for a fuzzy match. Billed like /reveal — 3 credits per
newly revealed match; previously-revealed matches are free within the
12-month cache. Unmatched inputs return status "not_found" (no charge).
Multiple inputs resolving to the same company are billed once; only the first
such input carries the charge. Ambiguous domains return 409 AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN
without billing; retry with verified company slugs.
Host precedence matches /companies/lookup: the exact current website wins
over subsidiaries or former websites; conflicting current owners still fail closed.
A lookup-card match must also be eligible for full public company data.
Delivered domain matches include domain_match explaining the matched host and evidence.
Misses carry coverage_status (not_in_coverage_scope, scope_review,
pending_enrichment, not_found, or invalid_domain for malformed input that was never searched). A miss does not enqueue research.
Batch size and hourly limits follow your tier's reveal limits.

200.description: Enrich results (normalized unique domains first, then unique slugs, in first-seen order within each group) + summary

coverage_status.description: Explanation for unmatched inputs; does not promise admission or an enrichment timeline.

409.description: Domain matches multiple companies (AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN); no charge.

get.description: FREE. Signing secrets are masked (whsec_…last4) — the full secret is only shown at creation.

post.summary: Create a webhook endpoint (Silver and up)
post.description:
Subscribe a URL to funding-round alerts. When a new funding round lands
for a company on your watchlist (`list_id` — one of your saved company
lists), or any company if unscoped, Indexed POSTs a signed JSON event
to your endpoint within ~5 minutes.

**Billing:** 1 credit per successfully delivered event. Test sends and
retries are free; a delivery is never charged twice (idempotent per
delivery id). Deliveries pause if your credits are exhausted and resume
on the retry schedule once topped up.

**Delivery + retries:** 10s timeout, HTTPS only, redirects refused.
Non-2xx responses retry on a backoff of 1m → 10m → 1h → 6h → 24h, then
dead-letter. 20 consecutive failures auto-disable the endpoint
(re-enable via PATCH `is_active: true`).

**Delivery semantics — at-least-once.** Like Stripe/GitHub webhooks, an
event may occasionally be delivered more than once (e.g. your endpoint
200s but the ack is lost, or a worker is reclaimed after a crash).
**Dedupe on `X-Indexed-Delivery-Id`** — process each id once. Billing is
exactly-once regardless: a given delivery is charged at most one credit
even if re-sent (idempotent per delivery id).

**Verifying signatures:** every request carries
`X-Indexed-Signature: t=<unix_seconds>,v1=<hex>` where
`v1 = HMAC_SHA256(secret, "{t}.{raw_body}")`. Recompute over the raw
body, compare constant-time, and reject if `|now - t| > 300s`:
```js
const [t, v1] = header.match(/t=(\d+),v1=([0-9a-f]+)/).slice(1)
const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`${t}.${rawBody}`).digest('hex')
const valid = crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected), Buffer.from(v1))
  && Math.abs(Date.now()/1000 - t) < 300
```
Requests also carry `X-Indexed-Event` and `X-Indexed-Delivery-Id`
(use the delivery id for idempotent processing on your side).

**Event catalog** — `funding_round.created` (new round, announced ≤90 days),
`funding_round.updated` (material correction to an existing round, ≤1/round/day),
`company.created` / `investor.created` (entity entered the visible index, fired once),
and `company.updated` (watchlist-scoped subscriptions only — requires `list_id`;
≤1/company/day). `domain.coverage.added` is opt-in and fires once per
endpoint/domain when a domain previously missed by that user becomes
API-resolvable. `company.*` payloads carry `data.company`, `investor.*`
payloads carry `data.investor`; the funding shape is below.

**Coverage-added payload** (`domain.coverage.added`):
```json
{
  "id": "<delivery uuid>",
  "event": "domain.coverage.added",
  "created_at": "2026-09-01T12:00:00Z",
  "data": {
    "requested_domain": "example.com",
    "company": { "id", "name", "slug", "website", "industries", "hq_city", "hq_country" },
    "domain_match": {
      "queried": "example.com",
      "canonical_domain": "example.com",
      "matched_via": "canonical_domain"
    }
  }
}
```

**Event payload** (`funding_round.created` / `funding_round.updated`):
```json
{
  "id": "<delivery uuid>",
  "event": "funding_round.created",
  "created_at": "2026-07-03T12:00:00Z",
  "data": {
    "company": { "id", "name", "slug", "website", "industries", "hq_city", "hq_country" },
    "funding_round": {
      "event_type": "series_b", "round_name": "Series B",
      "amount_raised_usd": 42000000, "announced_date": "2026-07-01",
      "post_money_valuation": 400000000, "press_url": "https://…",
      "investors": [{ "name": "Example Ventures", "is_lead": true }]
    }
  }
}
```
Endpoint limits: Silver 2, Gold 3, Platinum 10, Enterprise 25.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint (public host — internal/private addresses rejected)

list_id.description: Scope to one of your saved company lists (watchlist). Omit for all companies.

201.description: Created. `secret` (whsec_…) is returned ONLY here — store it to verify signatures.

get.description: Fetch a single endpoint you own, with its secret masked. Costs no credits.

404.description: Not found or not owned by you

patch.description: Update url/event_types/list_id/description or pause/resume via is_active. Re-enabling resets the failure counter.

404.description: Not found or not owned by you
Not found or not owned by you

post.description: Sends a sample event (flagged `"test": true`) shaped for one of the endpoint's subscribed types — pass `{"event_type": "..."}` to pick one, default is the first subscribed type. Never consumes credits.

Recurring CSV/JSON delivery. On each run the file is generated, stored privately, and an expiring signed download link (7 days) is emailed to your account address — never an attachment, never a public object. Each run bills the standard export credit schedule (1 credit per 10 rows; 3x with include_funding). Runs are capped at 5,000 rows — contact us for full-dataset Enterprise feeds.

columns.description: Registered export columns for the entity

include_funding.description: Append every funding event, including debt and exits; each row's counts_toward_total (Yes/No) marks whether it sums into total_funding_raised.

list_id.description: Scope to one of your saved lists. Omit for the full visible dataset (capped per run).

get.description: Last 50 deliveries with status (pending/delivered/failed/dead/credit_blocked), attempts, response codes, and credits_charged — the per-event billing audit trail. Test sends appear with event_type "test" and credits_charged 0.

post.description:
Unmask one or more entities from search results. 3 credits per newly
revealed entity (cached reveals are free). Accepts both slugs and UUIDs.

ids.description: Batch of entity slugs/UUIDs. Max per call: Free 5, Silver 5, Gold 10, Platinum 25, Enterprise 50.

get.description: FREE — does not consume credits. Returns tier, credit balance, and rate limits.

Returns canonical industry labels and their accepted aliases.
FREE and publicly accessible — no API key required.
Response is cached for 24 hours.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key in format `idx_<32chars>`. Available on every plan; entity detail and reveal spend credits on every plan, while bulk enrichment, webhooks, scheduled exports and listing/sorting require a paid plan (Silver+).

ownership_pct.description: Stated ownership percentage when a source gives it

total_funding_raised.description: Whole USD. Sum of disclosed itemized funding rounds at confidence 50+: equity rounds, notes, SAFEs, equity crowdfunding and grants. Grants are included; debt, IPOs, acquisitions and secondaries are not. Null when no counted round has a disclosed amount.

_revealed.description: true when this account has unlocked the entity's depth within 12 months

queried.description: Canonicalized domain supplied by the caller

canonical_domain.description: Current website host on the matched company

coverage_requested.description: true when the request was durably recorded for manual review; not a promise of admission or coverage. false means recording failed and the client can retry, or the domain belongs to a company outside coverage scope

coverage_status.description: Why this domain missed: queued (recorded for review), not_queued (recording failed), pending_enrichment (held, profile not yet servable), scope_review (held, scope under review), not_in_coverage_scope (held, outside coverage scope; never served)

coverage_eta_days.description: Currently null: manual review has no guaranteed completion date. Misses are never charged.

_revealed.description: true when this account has unlocked the entity's depth within 12 months

ProfileLoadState.description: Section read status, not a claim of historical data completeness. Full-record delivery rejects unsuccessful tracked section reads.

NullableCompanyReference.description: Visible parent or acquirer identity; null when no visible reference is recorded.

data_as_of.description: Last verified enrichment timestamp; null when unknown.

total_funding_raised.description: Whole USD. Sum of disclosed itemized funding rounds at confidence 50+: equity rounds, notes, SAFEs, equity crowdfunding and grants. Grants are included; debt, IPOs, acquisitions and secondaries are not. Null when no counted round has a disclosed amount.

last_valuation.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when undisclosed.

last_valuation_date.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when unknown.

owners.description: depth=standard and full. Companies that own this one, from reviewed, sourced relationships: its controlling parent (subsidiary, brand or division), or its joint-venture owners. This and subsidiaries share a bounded set of up to 200 relationships ordered by child name; empty means none in that returned set.

subsidiaries.description: depth=standard and full. Companies this one owns (subsidiaries, brands, divisions, joint ventures), from the same bounded set of up to 200 relationships as owners, ordered by child name.

acquisitions.description: depth=full only. Up to 100 visible acquisitions, most recent first; a bounded subset, not a complete acquisition history.

data_as_of.description: Last verified enrichment timestamp; null when unknown.

total_capital_deployed.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when undisclosed.

avg_check_size.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when undisclosed.

typical_check_size_min.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when undisclosed.

typical_check_size_max.description: Null at slim/standard depth or when undisclosed.

total.description: Total matches (always full count, regardless of reveal_status filter)

all_revealed.description: Present only when reveal_status=unrevealed and the first noncursor page verifies the complete nonempty match set is already revealed. Empty partial, cursor or later pages do not establish this; absence does not imply unrevealed matches exist.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for a paid key; null means the final page. Pass it as the cursor query parameter.

note.description: Present when this page used paid credits beyond the daily quota

depth.description: Only present while this page contains unrevealed results; points to the full-record endpoint

free_plan.description: Present when the key's plan does not have full API access

alternate_entities.description: Identity-only investor pointers when an exact company-domain lookup belongs to an investor; no private data

resolved_filters.description: Echo of resolved filter values (e.g., industries: ai-ml → AI/ML). Only present when filters are applied.

id.description: Entity identifier (UUID if input was UUID, slug if input was slug)

data.description: Full entity data (present when status is revealed or cached). Entity type determines the shape.

total_matched.description: Number of distinct matched companies; multiple inputs can match one company.

low_balance_threshold.description: Alert threshold for the active subscription or latest-pack bucket

low_balance_basis.description: Current bucket size used to derive the 10% threshold

db_variants_count.description: Number of DB industry values this label matches

ServiceUnavailable.description: Data or credit service unavailable. DATA_UNAVAILABLE means requested entity preparation failed before charging; retry later. SYSTEM_ERROR may have an unknown billing outcome after a lost deduction response; check credit usage before retrying.

AuthError.description: Missing, invalid, or insufficient API key

PaymentRequired.description: Credits exhausted, no active credit period, or overage cap reached (code CREDIT_LIMIT_REACHED). This is a billing state, not a rate limit — do not retry. Follow top_up_url to repurchase the returned top_up_pack.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded (code RATE_LIMITED). Back off and retry after Retry-After.
